    "summary": "Four edges were proposed: (1) boundary preparation combined with directory limitations could allow an unrecorded change; (2) sampling limitations may miss transient events; (3) shift log and area directory gaps together create a hazard scenario for unrecorded changes; (4) blank temporary instruction field combined with sampled data suggests potential undocumented issues.
